description: This file defines the 'Details' feature for user information retrieval within the application. It includes a query class, a validator for the query, and a handler that retrieves user data from the database, generates a JWT token, and returns an envelope with user details.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: Request object containing the username for fetching user details.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not null or empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the process of retrieving the user from the database, generating a token, and returning the user envelope.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Async method that fetches the user from the database, throws a not found exception if absent, maps the user to a DTO, generates a JWT token, and wraps it in a UserEnvelope.
